rules.statement: An application for letters of administration comes to an end with the death of the applicant prior to the issue of letters. Accordingly, where the last will of the deceased person is discovered after the death of the applicant for letters, application for probate of the will may be made without taking any steps to vacate an order absolute entered in the previous administration proceedings.
